title: Edit Customer has a Sales Representative field that lists Unassigned first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has two sales representatives, one staff member who is not a representative, and a customer with no representative.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Staff member {Staff-member-D} is active with the "Sales Representative" switch off.
    For example: {Staff-member-D} is ZZAUTOTEST Dan Noswitch.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer.
  2. Click the Sales Representative field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window shows a Sales Representative field in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the same outlined box as the other fields; the + shows beside it without hovering. No field has an x inside it.
  • Step 2: the dropdown opens. Reading it from top to bottom: "Unassigned" is first, then every active sales representative sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z (including {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}); {Staff-member-D} is not listed; there is no search box.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R1: “The Edit Customer window and the New Customer window both show a Sales Representative field, in the place Edit Customer shows it today, with the outlined box every other field in the window has.”
  • S4-R3: “Its dropdown starts with "Unassigned", followed by every staff member whose Sales Representative switch is on and whose account is active, sorted by first name, then last name, A to Z, as on the work order (S1-R8). Every one of them is listed, however many there are. It has no search box (S1-R12). The same list shows when the New Customer window is opened from a part sale by a user who can create part sales but not customers.”
  • S4-R4: “No field in the window has an x inside it; picking "Unassigned" clears it (S1-R10). Each field's dropdown arrow is vertically centered (S1-R11). In the window the + and the remove x are always shown; they do not wait for hover.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 15: “15. (a) "Unassigned" first, then A to Z by first name, then last name.”
